description: A fraction calculator for adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing — exactly. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

fractionA.description: The left operand as text: a fraction '3/4', a mixed number '2 3/4' or a whole number '5'. Negative values are allowed; decimals are not.

fractionB.description: The right operand, in the same forms as fractionA. Dividing by zero is refused.

operator.description: The arithmetic to apply: add, subtract, multiply or divide fractionA by fractionB.

name: fraction_calculator
title: Fraction Calculator
